fields.Name: T093 - Entity Form Individual Section Collapse Toggle
fields.Description: Exercises the per-panel collapse Toggle() on a single collapsible-panel header — distinct from bulk expand/collapse-all and from section navigation; verifies the individual chevron/Expanded state machine.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Members' entity via the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box, click a member row, then 'Open Full Record'. The form is organized into collapsible section panels, each with a header showing an icon, a title, and a chevron on the right. Click a single section's header (or its chevron) and confirm ONLY that one section collapses (its body hides and the chevron flips); click it again and confirm it re-expands. Success is a single section responding to its own header toggle. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Form sections render as collapsible panels with a header and a chevron indicator
Clicking a single section header collapses just that section's body, and clicking again re-expands it (chevron direction flips)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
